fields.name: Targets
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x3826A30 allocates 0x10 bytes zeroed; destructor bg3.exe+0x686280 = POD array. Windows per-frame update bg3.exe+0x3825D80 -> bg3.exe+0x3826350 walks the system's request map (keys: entity handles checked for ls::anubis::TreeComponent with bg3.exe+0x5DFB40; values: hash sets, keys array +0x20, count +0x2C, stride 0x30), fetches/creates the component and appends every 8-byte key not already present (linear search comparing whole 8-byte values; append bg3.exe+0x756460); the second loop removes them (swap with last). The requests come from the exported ls::anubis::EventsForwardingSystem::LEGACY_RegisterForEvents(ID<EntityHandleTraits> const&, ID<EntityHandleTraits> const&) / LEGACY_UnregisterForEvents - both arguments entity handles. Live: capacity 1, size 1.
